cases.source:
Repository PebbleAudit is a local Python CLI that previews CSV rows as JSON and never changes the input. Complete relevant file inventory: pyproject.toml, LICENSE, README.md, src/pebble/__init__.py, src/pebble/__main__.py, tests/test_preview.py. pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"
[project]
name = "pebble-audit"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = []
[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8"]
[project.scripts]
pebble-audit = "pebble.__main__:main"
[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
The __main__.py uses argparse with exactly --input(required) and --preview(store_true); main reads UTF-8 CSV and prints a JSON row preview, with no write operation. tests/test_preview.py contains source-only tests for ordered preview and unchanged input; no run log is supplied.
